author: Procsilas Moscas
attribution: Photo: Procsilas Moscas, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2010_signs_Lusaka_Zambia_4652340999.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hanging painted board on chains under an arcade in central Lusaka, with a blue Star of David at the left; 'rd' is superscript and the last line is in script. Other hanging boards are distractors and alternative targets: 'NET WAVE INTERNET CAFE & BUSINESS CENTRE / Wireless Technologies / BARBER SHOP' and 'ABYSSINIA COMPUTER CENTRE / Dealers In Computers & Accessories'; brand stickers (SAMSUNG, LG, D-Link, hp) on the shutters. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: afromusing
attribution: Photo: afromusing, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2011_Lumumba_Road_signage_Lusaka_Zambia_6172645252.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large blue-framed street-name panel with an advertiser's phone strip above ('Tel: 211 287 652', top cut off) and small 'ZID015/2' and 'PRIMEDIA' tags; a smaller 'KALAMBO ROAD' plate below is angled away. Traffic light in the foreground; a yellow 'Pet...' shop sign at the right edge is a distractor.
source_title: File:2011 Lumumba Road signage Lusaka Zambia 6172645252.jpg

author: SuSanA Secretariat
attribution: Photo: SuSanA Secretariat, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Signage_to_ministry_of_health_(5268486367).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Weathered white board on two posts in a flooded street in Kanyama, Lusaka (presumably the Kanyama clinic; LUDHMT = Lusaka Urban District Health Management Team). A line under KANYAMA is blacked out and partly peeled; posters stuck on the right half are unreadable. 'zain Top Up Here' A-frame is a distractor.

author: SuSanA Secretariat
attribution: Photo: SuSanA Secretariat, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lusaka-Zambia,_Pestalozzi_school.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted maroon-framed entrance sign of the Pestalozzi World school/children's village outside Lusaka, with a 'children around the globe' logo. The name is written as one word in a rounded humanist font with capital P and W.
source_categories: Schools named after Johann Heinrich Pestalozzi

author: Isaacgerg
attribution: Photo: Isaacgerg, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mumbuluma_falls_-_entrance_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted green National Heritage Conservation Commission board near Mansa. Only the name and header lines are transcribed; the fee table (Zambian Residents / Non Residents / Children below 5 Years FREE), 'VISITING HOURS: 08HRS-18HRS' and the script slogan 'A Zambia that Values its heritage for National Development' are secondary.

author: Sachoz
attribution: Photo: Sachoz, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_post_for_mpota.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted school board on two posts by a dirt road, Kawambwa, in warm low sun. The font draws lowercase 'l' like a small capital L ('RepubLic', 'GeneraL', 'IkuLa'); transcribed as ordinary lowercase. The motto is Bemba (ISO 639-3 'bem'). A small Zambian flag at top right.
